lines: This area was written in April of 1997 by Laurella.
Certain concepts and ideas used in this area are
based upon the work of Mr. Jeff Spurlin, and are
used with permission.
This area was designed for use by Carrion Fields
only.  Any other use without express written consent
from both the designer and Mr. Spurlin is
prohibited.
Special thanks go out to all the Immortal Staff of
Carrion Fields, for help testing this site, most
notably Pico for helping fix my gratuitous errors,
none of whom this would be possible without.
Thanks and kudos go out to all of you!
-Laurella
